test_policy.notes: International first-year applicants qualify with a high school GPA of 2.70 or equivalent (SAT/ACT not required), or with SAT 1030+ (reading + math) or ACT 20+. Students admitted on grades without scores take UCO's Computerized Placement Test before enrolling.

requirements.notes: Online application on UCO's own portal; $40 non-refundable fee. Documents: transcripts (equivalent of 12 years of schooling, with certified English translation if needed), English proficiency, passport, and for F-1 a bank statement (minimum $29,950 for a degree-seeking undergraduate) plus a Statement of Financial Sponsorship. UCO School of Music applicants also submit an audition form.

deadlines.label: Application (fall 2027): no published deadline
deadlines.notes: UCO states there are no specific application deadlines for undergraduate international applicants and recommends applying as early as possible for processing, visa and travel.

deadlines.label: Priority deadline for automatic international admission scholarships (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: The scholarships page lists 'May 31 (Fall)' with no year, treated as fall 2027. No separate scholarship application is needed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants from UCO's approved native English-speaking countries are exempt. Alternative: 12 weeks of intensive English at an approved U.S. ESL program after reaching a minimum TOEFL 48 iBT (460 PBT), IELTS 5.0, PTE 36 or iTEP 3.0. Students below the test minimums can apply for conditional admission and attend an approved 12-week Oklahoma ESL program, such as The Language Company on UCO's campus, before enrolling.

english.notes: 500 on the paper-based test is also accepted. The page does not give a new 1-6 scale minimum.
PTE Academic. iTEP Academic 3.5 is also accepted.

aid.notes: Applying for admission also applies for automatic freshman scholarships: Distinguished Global Scholar up to $16,000 over four years ($4,000/yr) for GPA 3.50 or SAT 1300 or ACT 28; Merit Global Scholar up to $12,000 ($3,000/yr) for GPA 3.25 or SAT 1250 or ACT 26; Honor Global Scholar up to $8,000 ($2,000/yr) for GPA 3.00 or SAT 1200 or ACT 24. Renewable with a 3.00-3.25 GPA. Extra funding (up to $4,500/yr total) for residents of Nigeria, Ghana, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand or Ivory Coast. UCO says it awards about $700,000 a year to international students.

cost.notes: International tuition page (undated, accessed 2026-10-26; labeled 2026-2027 as the current page): undergraduate tuition and fees $19,900 per year at 12 credit hours per semester, housing and dining $10,300 (nine months), books, insurance and miscellaneous $2,260 (in other_usd), total $32,460.

sat.note: UCO's international pages do not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: UCO ETS institutional code for TOEFL.

duolingo.note: Duolingo is not listed among UCO's accepted undergraduate English tests.
